synthetic_routing.interpretation: Known FK endpoint, synthetic q1/q2 constraints only; not physical collision validation.

self_collision_routing.interpretation: Known valid goal configuration; URDF convex self-collision proxies, no environment checking.

timing: CPU wall time, NumPy NN load excluded. Offline roadmap construction excluded from query timings; grow time recorded separately. Cache loading is not benchmarked. OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1.
interpretation: Self-collision mode: original held-out starts may be invalid; count them separately. Hull proxies are conservative and motion checks discretized. Roadmap seeds may improve endpoint IK. Numerical and NN multiseed variants share current/random/roadmap fallback seeds; NN adds four learned seeds (extra budget). Direct/PRM pairs have identical goal generation; compare them to isolate graph routing. Use attempts, success and timing to judge NN value, not only success on this small development set.
